name: Automated tire warehouse at Turkish Technic (LOG-X Systems)
category: AOG support: parts, rotables and technicians
summary: Turkish Technic has commissioned an automated tire warehouse at Istanbul Airport, supplied by LOG-X Systems. The 1,600 square meter system stores up to 3,770 tires and automates the process from storing tires to delivering them to the workshops, handling up to 120 tires an hour. Turkish outlet Herdem Aviation reported the commissioning on October 8, quoting Turkish Technic CEO Mikail Akbulut that automation robots and other technology cut tire delivery time to the workshops from 30 minutes to 6, an 80 percent improvement, and also improved workforce efficiency and traceability. LOG-X says the project was managed by Mopcons Consulting.

whyItMatters: Tires are changed often, and every minute spent finding and moving the right one is a minute an aircraft waits instead of earning. Cutting delivery from 30 minutes to 6 gets aircraft back in service sooner and frees the people who used to push tire carts. If your wheel and tire volume is high, time how long a tire takes from request to aircraft today before you price automation.
